name: Wasp trap
definition: a bait trap, dome, bag or sticky stick that lures and drowns or holds wasps, hornets and yellow jackets.
notes: Sold as wasp traps (PestFix; Pest Control Supplies wasp, bee and fly traps).

name: Fruit fly trap
definition: a small baited or sticky trap that catches fruit flies and other small flies around food.
notes: Sold as fruit fly traps (PestFix; Pest Control Supplies).

name: Clothes moth trap
definition: a pheromone glue trap that catches clothes moths in wardrobes and rooms.
notes: Sold as clothes moth traps (PestFix moth traps; Pest Control Supplies pheromone traps).

name: Fly paper
definition: a sticky strip, roll, reel or window sticker that catches flies on its glue.
notes: Sold as fly papers and sticky traps (PestFix).
